World renowned Naval Systems & Sensors company Thales Nederlands announced the opening of an avionics Systems & Sensors division. The company has the Royal Dutch Navy, the South-Korean navy, The French and German Navy's and the Royal British Navy (including the Super-carrier flagships) among it's customers to indicate the level of expertise. This new division will utilize the existing naval weapon, control and sensor systems for aerospace projects. The company will also pursue further expertise in avionic systems and future innovations.

The Division will start their participation in the Korean Aerospace Industries and Indonesian Aerospace prototype of the F-33 Boromae Fighter (KF-X Project). Currently we are further developing our Infra-red_search_and_track knowledge and remain in close contact with their partners in the project.

The new Division received an order from the Dutch government of 200 million usd to equip 5 ordered Boeing C-14 Clipper airplanes into "Airborne early warning and control" aircraft. (AWACS) Converting the current SMART-L radar system and 3-D Active Phased Array Radar into an airborne variant. The planes will arrive in September 2022 and are expected to be customized and ready for operation in July 2023.
